structural_result: Every minimum branch counterexample is a once-per-edge triangle expansion of a simple cubic base, using fewer than n/2 edges; the empty marking remains allowed.
conditional_certificates: Two exact rational cubes cover all 2^39 markings of the sharp 26-vertex double; arbitrary chains follow by a proved reduction.
rooted_attachment_result: Both boundary states survive arbitrary triangle chains with the half-size lower bounds stated in the paper.
failed_unproved_extension: Do not infer that marked edges form a matching. Deleting two triangles incident through a base vertex does not let one adjoin both triangles when their remaining outside neighbours are selected.
scope: Structural and infinite-family results; no unrestricted resolution.
